items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And we had great rhythm players — Mel Lewis was the drummer and Richard Davis was the bass player. I never had so much fun being in a rhythm section.

ctx.x: I’m looking at some of the guys you played with — Ben Webster, what was he like to work with?

Well he was pretty scary. I mean he was inspirational to me. I was in the middle of my Duke Ellington period when I got the job so I was really ready for it you know. And it was a wonderful learning experience for me and so much fun musically, I can’t tell you. It was a really nourishing musical thing. And we had great rhythm players — Mel Lewis was the drummer and Richard Davis was the bass player. I never had so much fun being in a rhythm section. They were so good. And they just, we just sailed along. It was…
Someone once said to you, “Jazz is okay but it ain’t got no words.”
